name: LinkedIn Post Pipeline - Gather to Fact-Checked Draft (Groq)

nodes.name: STEP 1 - Gather (Input Fields)
nodes.notes: Fill these manually per run. This is the handoff contract into Step 2 - every field here is a required input, no free text blob.

nodes.name: STEP 2 - Synthesize (Groq call 1)
nodes.notes: Handoff: outputs JSON with hook_angle, key_facts[] tagged verified/unverified, tone_notes. Response text lives at choices[0].message.content (parse it downstream).

nodes.name: STEP 3 - Draft (Groq call 2)
nodes.notes: Handoff: plain text LinkedIn post draft at choices[0].message.content, built only from tagged facts.

nodes.name: STEP 4 - Critique (Groq call 3)
nodes.notes: Handoff: {pass, issues[]} at choices[0].message.content. This is the gate - a human should never skip reading 'issues' even if pass is true.
